top_signals.title: Inflation Raises Stakes for Warsh’s Final Word in Bangkok
top_signals.summary: September’s hot inflation data lit up expectations that the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates this month, a prospect that appeared unlikely after policymakers in recent weeks signaled they had time to wait.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gold Rises as Treasury Yields Erase Gain After Inflation Data
top_signals.summary: Gold advanced, boosted by lower US Treasury yields as investors sought safety in bonds after hot inflation data bolstered rate-hike bets and triggered an equity selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: RBNZ Chief Economist Says Next Interest Rate Call ‘Wide Open’
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s interest rate decision in late October is “wide open,” according to Reserve Bank chief economist Paul Conway, even as inflation pressures build.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: EXCLUSIVE: Fed's Daly says rate hikes likely needed, but not urgently  Reuters
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
